notes: World->radar transform: px = (x - originX) / scale, py = (originY - y) / scale, in original radar image pixels (imageSize x imageSize). Status 'verified' = real-demo play-coverage check passed on every floor (worker/tools/radar_alignment.py); 'calibrated-unverified' = official values, no real demo checked yet. Radar images: web/public/radars (Valve assets via MurkyYT/cs2-map-icons, see docs/assets-and-licences.md).
